description: This PHP file is part of the vtiger CRM project and is responsible for verifying database health, checking table configurations, and providing an HTML interface for database checks and fixes.

classes.name: DBHealthCheck
classes.description: A class that performs health checks on the database, including checking table engine types and getting lists of unhealthy tables.

methods.name: updateTableEngineType
methods.description: Updates the storage engine type of a specific table.

methods.name: updateAllTablesEngineType
methods.description: Updates the storage engine type for all tables in the database.

methods.name: getUnhealthyTablesList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tables that are not configured properly, e.g., not using InnoDB.
